tasks.title: Release skill: release-preflight.ts, CLI subcommand, SKILL.md, plugin manifests, tests
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/lib/release-preflight.ts` is a new file (~60 LOC) exporting `runPreflightChecks(repoRoot)` returning `{ checks, version, tag, notes }`. Six blocking checks (`on-main`, `clean-tree`, `in-sync-with-origin`, `valid-version`, `changelog-section`, `tag-absent`) and two warnings (`npm-authenticated`, `gh-authenticated`) are implemented per the design spec table. Each check shells out via `child_process.execSync`; errors are captured into the per-check `message` field and never bubbled to the caller.

`reference-impl/lib/cli.ts` contains a new `release-preflight [--json]` subcommand case. Plain mode prints a human check list (one line per check, prefixed `✓`/`✗`/`⚠`) and exits 0 if all blocking checks pass, 1 otherwise. JSON mode emits `{checks, version, tag, notes}` to stdout and always exits 0.

`reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-release/SKILL.md` is a new skill file accepting `[--dry-run] [--yes]` flags. Flow: parse flags → call `cloverleaf-cli release-preflight --json` → display checks → bail on any blocking failure → display plan (5 commands + version + notes preview) → if `--dry-run` exit 0 → if not `--yes` prompt y/N → execute the 5 commands sequentially with bail-fast on first non-zero (`git tag -a`, `git push origin main`, `git push origin <tag>`, `cd reference-impl && npm publish --access public`, `gh release create --notes-file /tmp/release-notes-$VERSION.md`).
The new skill is registered in `reference-impl/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` at the repo root.

`reference-impl/tests/release-preflight.test.ts` is a new file containing exactly 10 cases covering: (1) all blocking pass, (2) detached HEAD, (3) feature branch name in message, (4) untracked files, (5) behind origin/main, (6) invalid semver version, (7) CHANGELOG section absent, (8) tag exists locally, (9) npm-authenticated warning fail, (10) multiple blocking failures composed.

`reference-impl/tests/cli.test.ts` is extended with 2 new cases: (1) `release-preflight --json` happy-path fixture → valid JSON with `checks/version/tag/notes`, exit 0; (2) `release-preflight` plain against a failing fixture → output contains `✗`, exit 1. `reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts` is extended with 1 regression case asserting `cloverleaf-release/SKILL.md` exists and contains `cloverleaf-cli release-preflight`, `git tag -a`, `git push origin`, `npm publish`, `gh release create`.
acceptance_criteria: `/cloverleaf-release --dry-run` prints the pre-flight check list and the 5-command release plan then exits 0 without executing any release command.
`/cloverleaf-release --yes` runs all 5 release commands unattended and prints `✓ Released reference-impl-v<version>` on success.
`/cloverleaf-release` (no flags) runs pre-flight, prints the plan, prompts `Proceed with release of <tag>? (y/N)`, and executes the 5 commands on `y`.
Pre-flight detects each of the 6 blocking failures independently; warning-level checks (`npm-authenticated`, `gh-authenticated`) render with `⚠` on failure but do not block execution.
`npm test` in `reference-impl/` passes all tests including the 13 new cases added by this task (10 in `release-preflight.test.ts`, 2 in `cli.test.ts`, 1 in `skills.test.ts`).

tasks.title: Walker SKILL.md: --idle-after adoption, token vocabulary refresh, auto-call prep-worktree
definition_of_done: All `claw-drive watch` invocations in step 5c of `reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` append `--idle-after 600` so children emit synthetic `idle` events after 10 minutes of silence.

A new `idle` event handler is added in step 5d: when `silent_for_ms >= 600000` arrives for a child session in `qa`-or-higher task state, the walker calls `claw-drive status <child_session_id>` to read `last_token`; if `last_token` is `[DONE]` or the on-disk task status is `final-gate`/`automated-gates`, the child is treated as terminal and drain proceeds.

All retired claw-drive 0.5.7 token references are replaced in `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md`: `[INFO-FINISHED]` → `[DONE]`, `[NEEDS-DECISION]` → `[NEEDS-INPUT]`; all occurrences of `[INFO-CHECKPOINT]` and `[INFO-PROGRESS]` are removed. The file contains no remaining references to any of the four retired token names.

In step 5b of `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md`, `cloverleaf-cli prep-worktree <repo_root> "$WT"` is called immediately after `git -C <repo_root> worktree add "$WT" -b cloverleaf/<TASK-ID> main` and before `mcp__claw-drive__start_session`.

`reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts` is extended with 4 new regression cases asserting: (1) `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` references `--idle-after` in a watch-command context; (2) `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` calls `cloverleaf-cli prep-worktree` after `git worktree add`; (3) `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` does not contain `INFO-FINISHED`, `NEEDS-DECISION`, `INFO-CHECKPOINT`, or `INFO-PROGRESS`; (4) `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` contains an idle event handler referencing `claw-drive status`.
acceptance_criteria: `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` `claw-drive watch` invocations include `--idle-after 600` and the file contains an idle handler that calls `claw-drive status <child_session_id>` when `silent_for_ms >= 600000`.
`cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` contains zero occurrences of the strings `INFO-FINISHED`, `NEEDS-DECISION`, `INFO-CHECKPOINT`, and `INFO-PROGRESS`.
`cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` step 5b calls `cloverleaf-cli prep-worktree <repo_root> "$WT"` after `git worktree add` and before `mcp__claw-drive__start_session`.
`npm test` in `reference-impl/` passes all tests including the 4 new regression cases added by this task in `skills.test.ts`.
